text:
Kellan: quick heads-up — I reorganized the optkit batching and cache docs into examples/batching/ and examples/cache/. PR #5234
Maya: Which links are failing in staging?
Kellan: Staging linkcheck shows ~9 failures: a mix of SDK snippet imports and docs links to old quant profile anchors.
Ibrahim: paste the top 5 pls
Kellan: sure:
- docs/cookbook/throughput.md -> references /optimize/examples/batching_v1.json (gone)
- docs/snippets/python/kv_prefetch.py -> import redwood.optimize.prefetch (ModuleNotFound)
- docs/guides/migration.md -> anchor /optimize/quant_profiles/legacy#bf16 (legacy anchor)
- src/snippets/js/batch_example.mjs -> imports "../examples/batching_v1" -> 404
- docs/includes/kv-usage.rst -> include path missing

Maya: Ugh. We should do a small data-driven redirect map + a snippet-preprocessing hook in the docs build. That gives immediate safety while we open canonical snippet PRs.
Ibrahim: Agreed. I can add a preprocessor `docs/_ext/snippet_rewrite.py` that reads `docs/_data/optkit_redirects.yml` and applies targeted regexes to snippet content during staging builds. Low risk.
Kellan: Great. Proposed YAML mapping (docs/_data/optkit_redirects.yml):
```yaml
- old: "optimize/examples/batching_v1.json"
  new: "optkit/examples/batching/shortseq/batching_smallseq_v2.json"
- old: "optimize/kv_prefetch_example.py"
  new: "optkit/examples/cache/kv-prefetch-python-0.5.py"
- old: "optimize/quant_profiles/legacy"
  new: "optkit/quant-profiles/legacy.md"
```
Maya: I'll open a tiny PR to update the JS snippets imports and change top-level await to async IIFE so lint passes. Ibrahim, you can own the Python snippet fixes?
Ibrahim: Yep. I'll grep `grep -R "redwood.optimize" -n src/snippets | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u` and send a patch. Plan to replace with `redwood.optkit` and append `# MIGRATION: canonical -> /optkit/...` to the top of each file.
Kellan: Lee (cc @lee) asked us to preserve anchors where possible. Can the redirect pages include a small client-side anchors.json that maps old tokens -> new fragment IDs?
Ibrahim: Yes. I'll add `docs/_static/anchor_aliases.json` and the redirect template will run a tiny script to remap `location.hash` if needed.
Maya: docs-bot, can we get a staging preview after the redirect map and snippet hook are in? Post the URL here so we can re-run linkcheck.
docs-bot: Preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/5234 (linkcheck: 9 errors) :eyes:

Kellan: Owners & timeline:
- Ibrahim: python snippet fixes + migration comments (PR today)
- Maya: js snippet fixes + lint adjustments (PR today)
- Ibrahim: add anchor_aliases.json + client fallback (PR today)
- Kellan: add `docs/_data/optkit_redirects.yml` + small redirect generator in `docs/_ext/redirects.py` (PR today)

Maya: I can pick off 5 of the 9 linkcheck errors in my PR (mostly JS snippet imports and a cookbook link). Ibrahim: you take 3. Kellan: keep the last one (anchor mapping)
Ibrahim: One thing: some downstream repos import example files by exact filename. We should include alternate legacy filename variants in the YAML mapping (snake_case and kebab-case). I'll add both forms.
Kellan: Good call. Also do two-step delete: first redirects live for 14 days, then we remove old files. I'll update PR descriptions to include deletion date and CHORE ticket link.
Maya: small sed example I'll use for JS fixes: `sed -i "s|../examples/batching_v1|../examples/batching/shortseq/batching_smallseq_v2|g" src/snippets/js/*.mjs`
Ibrahim: Python sed I'll run: `git grep -l "redwood.optimize" | xargs sed -i "s/redwood.optimize/redwood.optkit/g"` then run unit import tests.
Kellan: docs-bot ping me once redirects PR builds so I can re-run full staging linkcheck and verify. If anything blocks, drop a quick sync. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Redirects PR built: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/5234-redirects (partial fix: 4 link errors remain) :white_check_mark:

Maya: Nice. I'll merge my JS fixes and follow-up with the small integration test for snippet imports tomorrow morning.
Ibrahim: Merged python snippets patch. Left migration comments in updated files. Re-ran linkcheck locally, 2 errors left (one anchor, one include).
Kellan: I'll own the anchor fallback mapping. Planning to map `bf16` and `fp16` legacy tokens to new ids and add a tiny script that scrolls accordingly. ETA EOD.
Maya: Thanks all. After anchors land we'll run a final linkcheck and then schedule deletion in 14 days. :rocket:
